title: No-Code AI Automation & Workflow Design
description: Build automated business workflows using no-code platforms combined with LLM prompting. Tests system integration, prompt chaining, error handling, and automation efficiency.

seo.overviewTitle: No-Code AI Automation & Custom GPT / Agent Building
seo.overviewBody: No-code AI automation connects LLMs with business tools without writing code. Automation specialists build Custom GPTs, configure OpenAPI action schemas, orchestrate Zapier / Make.com AI workflows, and automate email and document generation pipelines.

deliverables.title: 1. Custom GPT / Agent System Spec & Action Schema
deliverables.desc: Specification detailing Custom GPT system instructions, uploaded knowledge files, and OpenAPI action schemas.

deliverables.title: 2. Zapier / Make.com AI Automation Workflow
deliverables.desc: Visual automation flowchart connecting form triggers, LLM processing modules, and CRM output actions.

deliverables.title: 3. End-to-End Test Execution & Error Handling Log
deliverables.desc: Audit log verifying automated workflow triggers, JSON payload parsing, and error recovery handling.

faqs.question: How do OpenAPI Action Schemas work in Custom GPTs?
faqs.answer: OpenAPI schemas define third-party API endpoints (URL, method, parameters), allowing Custom GPTs to fetch live web data or push actions to external webhooks.

faqs.question: What are best practices for Custom GPT System Instructions?
faqs.answer: Use clear numbered sections: Role & Objective, Knowledge Context Usage, Response Format Rules, and Banned Actions.

faqs.question: How do you handle API timeouts in Make.com AI workflows?
faqs.answer: Add error handler modules ('Break' or 'Resume') to retry failed AI processing calls automatically before sending error alerts.
